description: English evaluation corpus. Synthetic clips are ground truth by construction (Windows SAPI TTS: the spoken text is known exactly); noisy clips are the same speech mixed with white noise; the real-speech clip stays unscored until a human verifies its reference. Audio is generated by scripts/make_eval_corpus.py and never committed. 1.1.0 adds proper-noun, punctuation, letter/digit-token, long-form and fast-speech (rate 2) clips, plus two more noisy variants.
